versions.content: If Development Error Reporting is turned on and parame- ter "sources" contains an unknown (unconfigured) wakeup source, EcuM_SetWake- upEvent shall not update its internal variable and shall send the ECUM_E_UN- KNOWN_WAKEUP_SOURCE error message to the DET module instead.

If EcuMDevErrorDetect is enabled, and parameter "sources" contains an unknown (unconfigured) wakeup source, EcuM_SetWakeupEvent shall not update its internal variable and shall report the ECUM_E_UNKNOWN_WAKEUP_ SOURCE to the Det instead.

If EcuMDevErrorDetect is enabled, and parameter "sources" contains an unknown (unconfigured) wakeup source, EcuM_SetWakeupEvent shall not update its internal variable and shall report the ECUM_E_UNKNOWN_WAKEUP_ SOURCE to the Det instead.
